name: Mirroring - New Source: Dataverse
description: Mirrored Dataverse is a native experience in Fabric which enables data professionals to securely access Dynamics 365 and Power Apps data in Dataverse from any Fabric workspace, and to combine all their business data with analytical data in Fabric OneLake. Mirrored Dataverse enables zero-copy, near real-time, secure access to Dataverse data with a few clicks without the need for complex data pipelines or third party integration tools.
